title: a-red-seal-is-one-trouble-under-one-identity-from-raise-to-clear

decisions.text: One identity per seal trouble, derived by one function at one address inside cairn/devices/tester, called by both the commit ladder (reseal.py) and the validation store's announce/clear. The function is D6's seal_trouble_identity(proof_path) in validation_store.py.
decisions.by: measured 2026-09-15: two emitters, two keys, 90 of 96 identities with raise != clear; Akien's standing 'we need to fix things that come up too. time to ticket those'
decisions.amended: 2026-09-16 by CC after rehearsal pass 1: forward pointer to D6 so D1 reads whole

decisions.text: The ladder emits a clear only for a key that stands raised (in this run, or in the log tree); a green reseal with nothing raised emits nothing. The reader is D7's standing_raises(log_home, recipient=); the check is D7's predicate at the clear site.
decisions.by: measured: seal-red-cairn-tools-base raised 4 / cleared 145 — 141 clears with no raise
decisions.amended: 2026-09-16 by CC after rehearsal pass 1: forward pointer to D7 so D2 reads whole

decisions.text: The identity's GRAIN — per proof or per component — is Akien's call; opened as a question bound to this ticket at cast.
decisions.by: open question open-f998fae25b35; the BUILDME lane holds until answered

decisions.text: The drain host, the trouble store's fold, and the 219 undrained emissions are OUT.
decisions.by: live trouble trouble-drain-has-no-host-the-beat-backstop-is-prose; the hand-run drain is asked in chat under c0e47b140309

decisions.text: STACK AT THE RAISE (Akien, open-f998fae25b35: 'a trouble should have it's diagnostic info too, so the call stack will be in there. if not, we make it so' — measured 0 of 249 raises carry one): DiagnosticBase.raise_trouble in cairn/tools/base/diagnostic.py adds detail["stack"] = traceback.format_stack()[:-1] (a list of strings, innermost last, the raise_trouble frame itself dropped) to EVERY raise before emit(); clear_trouble adds nothing. A caller-supplied detail is copied, not mutated. One tooth in cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_diagnostic.py: a raise through a fixture raiser under a temp log home lands a record whose values.detail.stack is a non-empty list whose last entry names the proof file and the line of the raise call.

THE ONE FUNCTION: def seal_trouble_identity(proof_path) -> str in cairn/devices/tester/validation_store.py (the store side — reseal.py already imports from it; base may not import a device; trouble may not be imported by tester). Body under the per-PROOF grain (open-69cd989012c4 standing; if the answer is per COMPONENT only this body changes): returns "seal-red-" + the proof's repo-relative path with .py stripped, slugged by reseal._SLUG (e.g. seal-red-cairn-devices-tester-proofs-test-reseal-door). reseal.trouble_identity is deleted and its three call sites (:361/:412/:484 raises, :437 clear) call seal_trouble_identity; announce_verdict_change (:561) and the green round-trip clear (:790) call it too — the string "validation-verdict-changed-" no longer appears in cairn/devices/tester. reseal.py's docstring paragraph 'ONE TROUBLE PER COMPONENT…' is replaced by one sentence pointing at this decision. ALTERNATE BODY, used if open-69cd989012c4 is answered per COMPONENT: returns "seal-red-" + the repo-relative path of component_root_for(proof_path) slugged by _SLUG (today's reseal body, e.g. seal-red-cairn-devices-tester), and the store's announce and round-trip clear then fold every proof of a component under that one key. Under EITHER answer the function's name, address, signature and all five call sites are the same; the builder picks the body from the recorded answer and nothing else changes.
decisions.amended: 2026-09-16 by CC after rehearsal pass 1: both bodies recorded so the build is determinate under either answer to open-69cd989012c4

decisions.text: THE READER AND THE CHECK (D2): def standing_raises(log_home: Path, *, recipient: str) -> set[str] in cairn/devices/tester/reseal.py reads only files named *.raise_trouble.json and *.clear_trouble.json directly under log_home (the raiser's own emission tree, ~/.cairn/logs/tester/0 live; a temp dir in proofs), sorted by filename (the stamp is the filename prefix), and returns the pointers whose LAST event is a raise or whose last clear has values.by != recipient. It imports nothing from cairn/devices/trouble and writes nothing. The ladder's clear at reseal.py:437 becomes: if identity in raised_this_run or identity in standing_raises(raiser.log_home, recipient=CLEARS_FOR): raiser.clear_trouble(...); else no emission. raised_this_run is a module-level set the three raise sites add to. log_home for a ModuleRaiser is the directory emit() writes into (diagnostic.py's home attribute).

THE PROOFS: (a) test_reseal_door.py gains three teeth on its existing fake-raiser + temp-root fixture: 'a green reseal with nothing raised emits no clear' (fake raiser records zero clears), 'ladder red then hand green leaves nothing outstanding for cc' (raise then TesterDevice.run_proof green → exactly one clear, same pointer, by cc; standing_raises afterwards is empty), and 'standing_raises reads raise/clear pairs' (a temp tree with raise k1, clear k1 by cc, raise k2, clear k2 by someone-else → {k2}). (b) test_the_seal_announces_itself.py gains 'the store's announce pointer equals seal_trouble_identity(proof) equals the ladder's raise pointer' — three strings compared on one proof path. (c) the census tooth in test_reseal_door.py reads the LIVE ~/.cairn/logs/tester/0 read-only, restricted to files whose stamp is later than git log -1 --format=%cI of this build's commit (skipped with a printed reason when git is absent, i.e. the hollow worktree), and asserts by invariant: every clear_trouble pointer after the bound has an earlier raise_trouble pointer after the bound, and no pointer has two cc clears without a raise between — never a count. All four proofs (test_diagnostic, test_reseal_door, test_the_seal_announces_itself, test_validation_store) are resealed under netns and name their teeth (77f15efd5a96).

intention: A red seal is one trouble under one identity from raise to clear, whoever turns it green.
why: Law 7: a raised trouble no clear can reach is a permanent error the record lies about — the log tree says ground-loop is red 7 times over while its seal is green. Law 6: the tester owns the seal, so it owns the one identity; two keys is two owners of one condition.
how: Measure first (done, n=1420 emissions in ~/.cairn/logs/tester/0): the ladder raises seal-red-<component> and clears it only when IT turns the seal green, and it also emits a clear for every green reseal with nothing raised (seal-red-cairn-tools-base: raised 4, cleared 145); the store raises and clears validation-verdict-changed-<proof> on its own round-trip; a hand seal (TesterDevice.run_proof by CC) clears the store's key and never the ladder's, so ground-loop stands raised 31 / cleared 24 and tree 11 / 7. Fix: one identity per proof, derived by one function both emitters import from the store side (base may not import the device; the store is the lower rung), keyed by the proof path; the raise names the proof, the clear names the same proof, and the ladder stops clearing what nothing raised. Then a fold-side proof: every raise in the log has at most one matching clear key, and the outstanding set after a hand seal is empty.
falsifier: DONE when (1) the tester's raise and clear of a seal trouble share ONE identity derived by one function at one address that both cairn/devices/tester/reseal.py and cairn/devices/tester/validation_store.py call; (2) a proof under a temp log root asserts that a seal turned red by the ladder and green by a HAND seal (TesterDevice.run_proof) leaves nothing outstanding for cc, and that a green reseal with nothing raised emits no clear; (3) the raise/clear census over ~/.cairn/logs/tester/0 restricted to emissions after the build commit shows every raised identity cleared under the same key once its seal is green and no clear without a prior raise. RED if any clear is emitted for a key nothing raised, or if the two files still spell the identity separately. WRONG INTENT if the two keys were meant as two troubles (component-level roll-up vs per-proof) — then the fix is a recorded pairing between them, not a merge; the open question decides which.
